visual_symptoms: Olive-green to dark velvety brown/black lesions. Dull circular velvety spots that pucker and curl the leaf lamina
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0g/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L during primary infection

disease: Black Rot / Frogeye Leaf Spot (Botryosphaeria obtusa)
visual_symptoms: Purple specks enlarging to tan/light brown centers with dark purple rings. 'Frogeye' spots with circular light centers and double concentric margins
treatment: Apply Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 1.0g/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2.0g/L

visual_symptoms: Brilliant bright orange-yellow circular spots. Bright yellow-orange spots on upper surface; small tubular aecia cups beneath
treatment: Spray Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 0.4g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0g/L at pink bud to petal fall

visual_symptoms: Uniform deep green glossy surface. Unblemished green lamina, clear venation, no lesions or cupping
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Deep glossy green lamina. Healthy smooth leaf surface without rust, spots, or chlorosis
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: White circular powdery felt patches on leaf surface. Patches of white talcum-like mycelial growth causing upward leaf curling and distortion
treatment: Apply Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 0.5g/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Vibrant emerald green. Intact leaf blades free of shot-holes, powdery mold, or necrotic spots
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Tan to grayish rectangular lesions delimited strictly by leaf veins. Strictly rectangular block lesions running parallel to leaf veins; turn gray with spores
treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1ml/L at tasseling (VT/R1 stage)

visual_symptoms: Golden brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules. Small circular to elongate cinnamon-brown uredinial pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L at first sign of pustules

visual_symptoms: Long grayish-green to tan cigar-shaped elliptical lesions. Large (2.5 - 15 cm) cigar-shaped or elliptical lesions with rounded ends
treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Deep vibrant green. Smooth green surface without pustules, stripes, or necrotic blight
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Small reddish-brown circular spots with dark brown margins. Circular necrotic spots with tiny black pycnidia specks arranged in rings inside lesion
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Kresoxim-methyl 44.3% SC @ 0.7ml/L before bloom

visual_symptoms: Interveinal yellow and red discoloration with green veins ('Tiger-stripe'). Dramatic 'tiger-stripe' necrosis between major veins while primary veins stay green
treatment: No chemical cure exists for internal trunk decay; apply wound sealants after pruning

visual_symptoms: Irregular dark brown to black angular lesions with yellow halo. Lesions are sharply delimited by leaf veinlets, giving an angular shape; leaf drops early
treatment: Apply Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Lush emerald green. Uniform green canopy without tiger stripes, black spots, or mold
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy yellow mottle across the leaf lamina. Blotchy mottle (yellow pattern does not mirror across midrib), yellow veins, upright leaves
treatment: Control psyllid vector with Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L

visual_symptoms: Raised corky tan/brown crater pustules with yellow chlorotic halo. Raised blister-like eruptions on both sides of leaf surrounded by distinctive oily water-soaked yellow halo
treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L + Streptocycline (antibacterial) @ 100ppm

disease: Peach Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas arboricola pv. pruni)
visual_symptoms: Small angular dark purple to black water-soaked lesions. Center of lesions dries, cracks, and falls out, creating a distinct 'shot-hole' appearance
treatment: Spray Oxytetracycline @ 150ppm or Copper hydroxide at low rates during growing season

visual_symptoms: Smooth glossy vibrant green. Flawless green lamina without shot-holes, leaf curl, or bacterial specks
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Small circular to irregular dark brown water-soaked lesions with yellow halo. Lesions on lower leaf surface appear blistered; leaves turn yellow and drop prematurely
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptomycin sulfate @ 100ppm every 7-10 days

visual_symptoms: Uniform glossy dark green. Smooth, flat, unblemished leaves with no chlorosis, leaf curl, or spots
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Circular sunken spots with concentric rings of black acervuli specks. Necrotic patches on leaves; twigs die back from top downwards
treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric target rings (bullseye). Concentric rings surrounded by narrow chlorotic yellow halos, starting on oldest bottom leaves
treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L

visual_symptoms: Water-soaked dark green-black greasy lesions with pale chlorotic border. Rapidly enlarging dark water-soaked patches; white cottony fungal growth on underside in high humidity
treatment: Spray Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L or Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5g/L

visual_symptoms: Lush vibrant green. Clean green leaflets free of concentric spots, water-soaking, or white mildew
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Rich green upper surface with silver-white hairy underside. Intact healthy leaflets with sharp serrations and no rust or cane spots
treatment: None required.

disease: Soybean Brown Spot / Septoria Spot (Septoria glycines)
visual_symptoms: Small angular dark brown to red spots surrounded by chlorotic yellow halos. Small (2-5mm) angular irregular brown to bronze lesions on lower canopy; leaves turn yellow and drop early
treatment: Spray Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1ml/L at R3 (pod initiation) stage

visual_symptoms: Tan to reddish-brown tiny raised pustules on leaf underside. Volcano-like raised uredinial pustules packed with powdery spores causing rapid premature defoliation
treatment: Apply Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1.5ml/L at first detection of rust pustules

visual_symptoms: Lush vibrant green. Unblemished green leaf surface with active nitrogen-fixing vigor
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: White talcum powder-like patches covering both leaf surfaces. Round white powdery colonies coalescing to blanket the entire leaf blade; leaves yellow and dry crisp
treatment: Apply Myclobutanil 10% WP @ 0.5g/L or Penconazole 10% EC @ 0.5ml/L

visual_symptoms: Dark purple to reddish-brown blotches without light center. Irregular purplish-black blotches that coalesce; leaf edges curl up and appear scorched/burnt
treatment: Spray Captan 50% WP @ 2.5g/L or Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 1g/L

visual_symptoms: Small circular spots with white to ash-gray centers and dark purple-red halos. Classic 'bird's eye' spots (3-6mm) with pale whitish necrotic centers bordered by deep reddish-purple margins
treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide @ 2g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L at early vegetative stage

visual_symptoms: Glossy vibrant emerald green. Supple serrated leaflets completely free of purple spots, scorch, or powder
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Small dark brown to black circular lesions with greasy translucent halos. Numerous small (under 3mm) dark greasy specks; lesions may tear giving leaf a ragged shot-hole look
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptocycline @ 100ppm every 7 days

visual_symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric target rings (bullseye). Target-board concentric rings surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo, starting on lower mature leaves
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L

visual_symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green to dark purplish-black greasy lesions. Rapidly spreading large dark water-soaked patches; white fuzzy mold on leaf undersides during moist cool mornings
treatment: Spray Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2.5g/L

visual_symptoms: Pale yellow chlorotic blotches on upper surface; velvety olive-brown mold beneath. Diffuse pale yellow spots on upper leaf surface corresponding to olive-green to brown velvety sporulation underneath
treatment: Spray Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Small circular spots with ash-gray centers and dark brown margins. Numerous small (1.5 - 3mm) round spots with pale gray centers containing tiny black speck pycnidia
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L every 7-10 days

visual_symptoms: Fine yellow stippling, speckling, and bronzing on upper leaf surface. Dense yellow stippled pinpricks; fine silky webbing visible on leaf undersides and leaf axils
treatment: Apply Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Propargite 57% EC @ 2ml/L

visual_symptoms: Brown pinpoint spots expanding to circular lesions with light brown centers. Target-like circular lesions with subtle concentric rings and distinct yellow halos
treatment: Spray Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1ml/L or Boscalid @ 0.5g/L.

visual_symptoms: Intense interveinal chlorosis and yellow margins. Upward curling and cupping of leaflets, reduced leaflet size, bushy stunted plant habit
treatment: Control whitefly vector: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2g/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.3g/L

visual_symptoms: Mottled pattern of alternating light and dark green patches. Mosaic mottle of dark and light green islands, blistering of leaf surface, stunted growth
treatment: No chemical cure exists for viral diseases; manage vector and sanitation.

visual_symptoms: Deep uniform lush green. Firm supple leaflets with no spots, yellow halos, curling, or mildew
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Bright yellow-orange powdery pustules on underside; chlorotic spots on top. Circular yellow spots on upper surface; matching powdery orange-yellow spore pustules on the lower surface causing massive defoliation
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L as preventive contact shield

disease: Coffee Brown Eye Spot / Cercospora (Cercospora coffeicola)
visual_symptoms: Circular brown spots with light grayish centers and brilliant yellow halo. 'Eye-like' circular spots with ash-white center, brown margin, and wide yellow halo
treatment: Spray Copper Hydroxide @ 2g/L or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L

visual_symptoms: Deep waxy emerald green. Unblemished thick waxy leaf lamina without rust pustules or eye spots
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Spindle-shaped / diamond-shaped lesions with ash-gray center and brown border. Classic eye-shaped or spindle lesions with pointed ends, gray center, and reddish-brown margin
treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L

disease: Rice Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae pv. oryzae)
visual_symptoms: Water-soaked stripes turning wavy yellowish-white bleached lesions along leaf margins. Lesions begin at tip/margins as wavy yellowish-white stripes; leaves dry and look bleached white
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptocycline @ 100ppm

visual_symptoms: Oval to circular brown spots with dark brown halo and gray center. Uniformly distributed sesame-seed sized spots on leaf lamina; associated with nutrient-deficient soil
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Vibrant emerald green. Clean upright blades with clear parallel venation and no spindle lesions or bleached margins
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Bright yellow-orange powdery pustules arranged in continuous narrow stripes. Narrow linear stripes of lemon-yellow powdery uredinia running parallel to veins along entire leaf blade
treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L immediately at first yellow stripe

visual_symptoms: Small round to oval orange-brown scattered pustules. Scattered round orange-brown pustules randomly distributed across upper leaf surface (not in linear stripes)
treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L.

visual_symptoms: Deep vibrant green. Clean flag leaves with no rust stripes, powdery mold, or necrotic tips
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Dark green thickened veins; upward or downward leaf curling. Upward or downward cupping of leaves, prominent thickening of main veins, and cup-shaped leaf enations on underside
treatment: Control whitefly vector: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2g/L or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 2ml/L

disease: Cotton Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
visual_symptoms: Small angular water-soaked spots turning dark brown/black. Lesions are sharply delimited by veinlets giving an angular geometric appearance; black arm on stems
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + Streptocycline @ 100ppm

visual_symptoms: Lush emerald green. Supple unblemished lobed leaves with no vein thickening or angular spots
treatment: None required.

disease: Black Sigatoka / Black Leaf Streak (Pseudocercospora fijiensis)
visual_symptoms: Reddish-brown narrow specks enlarging to dark brown-black spindle lesions with gray center. Parallel dark streaks coalescing into large necrotic black blotches causing massive leaf collapse
treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L mixed with 1% mineral oil

visual_symptoms: Lush vibrant tropical green. Intact wide green lamina with no necrotic streaks or yellow borders
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Irregular dark brown to black necrotic lesions with yellow margins. Circular to angular dark brown spots; leaf tips blighted; young leaves tear and twist ('shot-hole')
treatment: Apply Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L at new vegetative flush

visual_symptoms: Glossy deep green. Unblemished thick leaf blades with clear midrib and no black spots or powdery mold
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Red lesions on midrib with dark borders; leaves wither yellow-brown from tip. Blood-red streaks studded with dark spots along the leaf midrib; whole crown withers and dries
treatment: Sett dip in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L before planting; foliar sprays cannot cure internal vascular rot

visual_symptoms: Deep vibrant green. Clean green blades with bright white midrib without red lesions or drying
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Translucent circular spots turning into blistered white velvety concavities. Raised convex pale green blister on upper leaf surface with a corresponding white velvety concave depression beneath
treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2g/L + Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 1ml/L every 7 days during monsoon

visual_symptoms: Vibrant emerald green. Clean glossy tender shoots and leaves free of blisters or red rust
treatment: None required.

disease: Groundnut Tikka Disease / Cercospora Leaf Spot (Cercospora arachidicola / Phaeoisariopsis)
visual_symptoms: Circular reddish-brown to dark brown spots surrounded by bright yellow halo. Multiple small circular necrotic spots with yellow rings on leaflets, causing extensive premature leaf shedding
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Deep rich green. Clean unblemished oval leaflets with no tikka spots or rust pustules
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Prominent raised creamy-white blister-like pustules on lower leaf surface. White chalky pustules scattered on underside of leaves; floral parts swell into distorted 'staghead'
treatment: Spray Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L

visual_symptoms: Lush vibrant green. Clean broad leaves free of white blisters or Alternaria concentric spots
treatment: None required.

visual_symptoms: Sunken purplish-brown elliptical lesions with yellow chlorotic margin. Small water-soaked areas that turn brown-purple with concentric rings; leaves break over at lesion point
treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L + sticker (Sandovit @ 1ml/L) or Tebuconazole @ 1ml/L

visual_symptoms: Bluish-green with natural waxy bloom. Firm upright tubular leaves with no purple spots, thrips silvering, or tip burn
treatment: None required.
